title: IKEA BARLAST Lamp Redesign – Wooden Rod Lamp
author: ARE_ngineering
description:
**Description**

A 3D printed redesign for the **IKEA BARLAST lamp**, made to give the simple lamp a much more unique and more custom look.

This design reuses the lamp electronics from an IKEA BARLAST and combines them with **Ø13 mm wooden rods** to create a tripod-style lamp. The wooden rod legs can be cut to different lengths, so the lamp height can be changed depending on how you want to use it.

With short legs, it works great as a table lamp, desk lamp, or nightstand lamp. With longer legs, it can be used as a lounge lamp or ambient floor lamp, perfect for adding soft light and a more relaxed look to a room.

The print is split into multiple parts, making it easier to print and assemble.

**Included parts**

• Lamp shade

Replaces the simple original BARLAST sheet shade and gives the lamp a more designed look.

• Lamp tripod leg mount

Replaces the original BARLAST stand. This part is assembled with the lamp electronics and the cut-to-size Ø13 mm wooden rods.

• Lamp feet

Fits onto the ends of the wooden rods to protect floors and tables from scratches. They also give the lamp a cleaner finish, especially if the wooden rods are not cut perfectly.

**Features**

• Redesign for IKEA BARLAST lamp

• Uses Ø13 mm wooden rods for the legs

• Adjustable height depending on rod length

• Great for ambient room lighting

• Multi-part print

• Feet protect floors and tables from scratches

**Assembly notes**

You will need the electronics from an IKEA BARLAST lamp and Ø13 mm wooden rods cut to your preferred length.

Assemble the lamp electronics with the printed tripod leg mount, insert the wooden rods, and add the printed feet to the ends of the rods. The lamp shade replaces the original BARLAST shade.

**Fit & performance**

The final height depends on the length of the wooden rods you choose. Short rods make it suitable for a table, desk, or nightstand, while longer rods turn it into a lounge or ambient floor lamp.

The printed feet help protect the surface the lamp stands on and also make the rod ends look cleaner.
